behavior: Retain changes review state only; titles, bodies, chapter numbers and order remain unchanged.
Pending and processed lists separate review workflow from structural validity. Persisted findings can be reopened from the shelf and revoked.
Content-bound decisions and edited sections commit atomically. Save failures remain visible and do not publish frontend state.
Reimport reuses matching decisions for the same book identity; changed content, context or positions invalidate stale keys.

Navigation uses section identity and targets its heading with a direct jump. Deleted sections do not fall back to a neighbor; undo uses the actual chapter position. Volume regression uses its true first section.
